purpose: Build the site-side spatial scaffold before any macroecological demographic outcome is modeled.

source_sites.candidate_gate: at least 5 distinct nest-count years spanning at least 10 years
source_sites.outcome_blind_constraint: Only site coordinates, species identity, and temporal-coverage metadata may be used. Population trend direction, effect sizes, and endpoint outcomes are not used in Gate 1A.

scar_add.dataset: High resolution vector polygons of the Antarctic coastline

spatial_match_audit.selection_rule: Choose the smallest distance at which at least 95% of candidate sites have one or more land-polygon matches and no more than 5% have multiple land-polygon matches. If no distance satisfies both criteria, Gate 1A fails and no site-type classification is opened.

next_gate_only_if_passed.name: Gate 1B island/mainland classification
planned_derivations: distance to continental land for offshore islands
prohibited_before_gate1a_pass: choosing a spatial tolerance based on demographic outcomes
